'''Yoshinori Sonobe''' (Japanese: '''園部好徳''' ''Sonobe Yoshinori'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Sonobe was born on July 7, 1977, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|GS}}, but got his most notable role in that work, [[Pokémon Contest]] judge [[Mr. Sukizo]], during {{aniseries|RS}} and {{aniseries|DP}}. Sonobe is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Production Baobab}}.
